_doc: Controlled decode-throughput benchmark. Three operating points per length:
No CROSS-REQUEST prefix sharing: every prompt is a distinct random token
stream. Each request's OWN prefix is warmed before measuring, without which
a bs=max cell never forms -- prefilling 64 x 30k takes minutes while 1024
decode tokens take seconds, so early requests would finish generating
KV_SPLITS is pinned on every arm so all arms compare at the same decode
schedule. ARTIFACTS ARE SYNTHETIC (random rotations + random codebook):
nova_cuda = nova + SGLANG_VQ2_CUDA=1: identical maths, decode stage-1 runs
the CUDA kernel (codebook staged in shared memory) instead of Triton.
